name: @subline/installer

scripts.//pack:dir: Packaging is a CONFIG step, not a rewrite: build:mod produces build/mod, build:app produces dist, and electron-builder copies both. Named pack:dir because `pnpm pack` is one of pnpm's own builtins and would shadow it. CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false is belt-and-braces on top of electron-builder.js's `identity: null` default: an unsigned local build must never reach the keychain.
scripts.pack:dir: pnpm build:mod && pnpm build:app && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: pnpm build:mod && pnpm build:app && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder
scripts.//dist:mac: UNSIGNED. Signing is opt-in and belongs to the release engineer: `SUBLINE_SIGN=1 SUBLINE_NOTARIZE=1 pnpm dist:mac`, with the credentials in docs/RELEASING.md. The default must never touch the keychain.
scripts.//dist:win: Unsigned, deliberately — spec §1 and §10. See docs/RELEASING.md for what SmartScreen does about it.
scripts.//release: Clean checkout → signed, notarized, stapled artefacts + the release manifest. One command. Needs the credentials named in docs/RELEASING.md.

//engines: buildMod.mjs imports src/bundle/spec.ts directly, so that the checks the build runs and the checks the installer runs are the same code. packaging/hooks.mjs does the same. Node strips TypeScript types without a flag from 22.18 on.
